+## What
+
+Create `Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/DeepseekV4Compressor.swift` — DSV4's compressed sparse attention (`Compressor` + `Indexer`), the mechanism behind its 1M-token context.
+
+**Deliberately deferred until basic support works.** Everything before this task ships a working DSV4 for short prompts; `sanitize` in task `pwr8r3h` drops `compressor.*` and `indexer.*` keys precisely so the model loads without this. That filter must be **removed** as part of this task.
+
+Port from `scouzi1966/mlx-swift-lm` @ `main`, `Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/DeepseekV4Compressor.swift` (1164 lines).
+
+Config drivers (already decoded by task `6f6qmf7`): `sliding_window=128`, `compress_ratios[i] ∈ {4, 128, 0}` selecting per-layer behavior, `index_n_heads`, `index_head_dim`, `index_topk`. Layers with `compress_ratio == 0` use plain attention; nonzero values engage the compressor at that ratio.
+
+This is the same architectural family as the sparse attention upstream `mlx-lm` introduced in `mlx_lm/models/deepseek_v32.py` — worth reading as a second reference, since we do **not** have a `deepseek_v32` port to build on.
+
+Sizing warning: at 1164 reference lines this is the largest single unit in the workstream and likely exceeds the 500-line guideline. +

+- Reference: `scouzi1966/mlx-swift-lm` @ `main` — `Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/DeepseekV4Compressor.swift` (MIT; header attributes Osaurus AI).

+- Second reference for the sparse-attention family: `ml-explore/mlx-lm` `mlx_lm/models/deepseek_v32.py`.
+- Apply the attribution header decided in task `jhk0apk`.
+

+
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/DeepseekV4Compressor.swift` exists with the `Compressor` and `Indexer` modules.

+- [ ] A long-context prompt (beyond `sliding_window=128`) produces coherent output.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] New `Tests/MLXLMTests/DeepseekV4IndexerTests.swift`: causal-mask property test — for every query position, every selected key index is ≤ the query index, across randomized inputs.
+- [ ] New `Tests/MLXLMTests/DeepseekV4CompressorTests.swift`: pooled-KV shape for `compress_ratio` 4 and 128; `allFinite`.
+- [ ] Test: `compress_ratio == 0` path is bit-identical to the plain-attention path.

+- [ ] Regression: re-run `swift test --filter DeepseekV4ModelTests` — still green, proving short prompts did not change.
+- [ ] Run: `swift test --filter 'DeepseekV4Indexer|DeepseekV4Compressor'` — all pass.
